title: Claude how to: a visual, example-driven guide that takes you from basic prompts to AI orchestration
description:
If you use Claude Code but feel like you're only scratching the surface, this repo is for you.  Claude how to is a visual, example-driven guide that takes you from basic prompts to AI orchestration. Copy-paste templates for advanced agents, custom workflow hooks, specialized skills, and MCP servers. It even ships a self-assessment command you run directly in your terminal to find exactly which features you're missing.

https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto

#github #opensource
